items.title: Efficient and accurate systems for querying unstructured data
items.author: stacks.stanford.edu via typesanitizer
items.summary_raw:
Abstract: (shortened)

In recent years, automatic analysis over this unstructured data has become possible via machine learning (ML). Analysts can use ML to extract structured information from these unstructured sources, such as object types and location from a video. The structured information can subsequently be used in downstream analysis, e.g., the urban planner can count the number of cars that passed by an intersection.

Unfortunately, using ML for these analyses is challenging. Deploying ML is prohibitively expensive for many organizations: naively analyzing a year of video from a small town can cost millions in cloud compute credits. ML methods are also unreliable, returning incorrect results, which can lead to downstream errors. Finally, deploying ML for analytics requires knowledge of deep learning, data systems, programming, and other technical skills.

In light of these challenges, we make two observations: many applications can tolerate approximations, if there are guarantees on accuracy, and methods for answering unstructured data queries range by up to 10 orders of magnitude in cost. In this dissertation, we develop systems and algorithms for efficient and reliable unstructured data analytics, leveraging the two observations. Instead of returning exact answers, we return approximate answers generated by cheap approximations to expensive ML methods.

Our systems can return statistically valid answers on a wide range of query types, including selection, aggregation, and limit queries. Furthermore, our systems can be up to orders of magnitude cheaper than standard methods of answering queries

Comments
items.summary: 这是斯坦福的一篇博士论文，研究如何高效、可靠地对非结构化数据（如视频）进行查询分析。作者指出直接用 ML 处理非结构化数据成本极高且结果不可靠，因此提出利用两个观察：许多应用可容忍近似结果（只要有精度保证），且不同查询方法的成本可相差十个数量级。论文设计了返回统计有效近似答案的系统与算法，支持选择、聚合、limit 等查询类型，成本可比标准方法低数个数量级。

items.title: Are Latent Reasoning Models Easily Interpretable?
items.author: arxiv.org via Yogthos
items.summary_raw:
Models normally do all their reasoning in a continuous hidden state instead of spitting out readable text which makes them hard to monitor. The authors tested the Coconut and CODI models and it turns out these models barely even use their hidden reasoning steps for logical tasks like PrOntoQA and ProsQA. You can force the models to stop thinking early and they almost always spit out the same response anyway. It turns out that their high performance on logical tasks actually comes from their specific training data rather than the extra thinking during inference.

Things get even more interesting when the models actually need those reasoning tokens for math problems. The researchers wanted to know if standard step-by-step math solutions were hidden inside the latent space, and projected the hidden states back into regular vocabulary words to check. And sure enough when the models got the math problem right the researchers found the correct intermediate math steps in their hidden states up to 93% of the time. The finding strongly suggests that the models are basically doing standard math steps in the background.

They confirmed the exact math operations taking place by tweaking numbers in the prompt and seeing how the hidden states reacted which allowed decoding a verified reasoning path for a large majority of correct predictions. But they could rarely do this for incorrect predictions proving that models are actually way more interpretable than the AI community assumed. And you can even use that interpretability as a signal to guess if the model is about to give a right or wrong answer.

Comments
items.summary: 该研究检验了潜在推理模型（Coconut、CODI）的可解释性：在 PrOntoQA、ProsQA 等逻辑任务上，模型几乎不依赖隐藏推理步骤，提前截断思考也几乎不改变答案，其表现主要来自训练数据而非推理时的额外计算。但在数学任务中，将隐藏状态投影回词表后，正确预测中有高达 93% 能解码出正确的中间步骤，说明模型实际在隐空间执行标准分步计算。作者还通过扰动提示中的数字验证了具体运算，并指出该可解释性可作为判断答案对错的信号。

items.summary: OpenAI 与美国总务署（GSA）合作，向符合条件的联邦、州、地方及部落政府提供零许可费、使用量五折以及扩展的网络防御支持。此举旨在降低公共部门采用 AI 的门槛，同时强化政府机构的网络安全能力。对关注 AI 政策落地、政企合作模式及公共部门 AI 采购趋势的读者具有参考价值。

items.title: Build more natural voice experiences with GPT‑Live‑1 in the API
items.summary_raw: GPT‑Live‑1 brings natural, full-duplex voice conversations to the API, with stronger instruction following, custom voices, and telephony support.
items.summary: OpenAI 发布 GPT-Live-1，将全双工（full-duplex）语音对话能力开放到 API，支持更自然的实时打断与轮次切换，并新增自定义音色与电话（telephony）集成。相比此前基于级联 ASR→LLM→TTS 的方案，全双工模型能降低延迟、保留副语言信息，让语音 Agent 更接近真人对话体验。对做语音助手、客服机器人、实时语音 Agent 的开发者而言，这是可直接接入的基础能力升级，值得关注其定价、延迟指标与电话链路合规性。

items.title: Introducing the Agents API
items.summary_raw: Build and launch cloud agents with the Agents API, a managed service powered by the Codex harness for orchestration, long-running sessions, and tool use.
items.summary: OpenAI 发布 Agents API，这是一个托管式云服务，底层由 Codex harness 驱动，用于编排、长时间运行会话与工具调用。它把构建和部署云端 Agent 的复杂度（会话持久化、工具执行、任务编排）封装为 API，开发者无需自建运行时即可上线生产级 Agent。作为 OpenAI 官方 Agent 基础设施，它标志着 Agent 从框架层走向平台化托管服务，值得关注其对现有 Agent 框架生态的冲击。

items.title: Paul Christiano joins OpenAI Foundation Board
items.summary_raw: Paul Christiano joins the OpenAI Foundation Board and its Safety and Security Committee, bringing experience in AI alignment, safety, and standards.
items.summary: OpenAI 宣布 AI 对齐领域知名研究者 Paul Christiano 加入其基金会董事会及安全与安保委员会。Christiano 是 RLHF 与 AI 对齐研究的早期奠基者之一，曾任职 OpenAI、创办对齐研究中心 ARC，此次任职意味着安全治理层获得更强的技术对齐视角。对关注前沿实验室治理结构、AI 安全政策走向的读者有参考价值，但本身不涉及技术细节。

items.title: The AI policy window is open. We need to act.
items.summary_raw: Chris Lehane argues that stronger AI capabilities require stronger safety evidence, shared standards, and durable policy action while the policy window remains open.
items.summary: 这是 OpenAI 高管 Chris Lehane 撰写的政策倡议文章，核心论点是 AI 能力越强，越需要与之匹配的安全证据、行业共享标准和稳定的监管框架，并呼吁在政策窗口尚未关闭时尽快行动。文章本身不含技术细节或可复现方法，价值在于它反映了头部 AI 实验室对监管议题的官方立场与游说方向，可作为观察 AI 治理政策走向、理解厂商与立法者博弈的一手材料。

items.title: GPT-6 Astra: The next generation in intelligence for work
items.summary_raw: Meet GPT-6 Astra, OpenAI’s most capable model for business, with advanced reasoning, computer use, and stronger writing and design judgment.
items.summary: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Astra，定位为面向商业场景的最强模型，主打高级推理、计算机操作（computer use）以及更强的写作与设计判断力。这是继 GPT-5 之后的下一代旗舰，标志着模型能力重心从通用对话进一步转向可执行的工作流自动化与专业内容生产。对开发者和企业而言，值得关注的是 computer use 能力的成熟度，它直接关系到 Agent 能否可靠地操作真实软件界面。

items.title: How GPT-5.6 Sol helps run quantum computing experiments
items.summary_raw: See how an MIT researcher uses GPT-5.6 Sol with Codex to autonomously run quantum computing experiments, analyze results, and calibrate qubits.
items.summary: OpenAI 官方博客介绍 MIT 研究者如何用 GPT-5.6 Sol 配合 Codex 自主运行量子计算实验、分析结果并校准量子比特。该案例展示了 LLM 从代码生成工具向科研自动化代理的延伸：模型不仅写代码，还参与实验闭环中的决策与迭代。对关注 AI for Science、Agent 自主执行与代码智能体落地边界的人有参考价值，但属厂商宣传性案例，缺少可复现的量化细节。

items.title: The Work Now Within Reach
items.summary_raw: Explore how more capable, affordable AI can expand the work people and businesses can accomplish—and make growth more economical.
items.summary: 这是 OpenAI 官方博客发布的一篇观点性文章，主题是更强大且更廉价的 AI 如何扩展个人与企业可完成的工作边界，并让增长更具经济性。文章并非技术论文或产品发布，而是面向商业与政策受众的叙事性内容，旨在传递 AI 能力提升与成本下降将带来生产力扩张的信号。对关注 AI 商业化落地、定价趋势与行业叙事的读者有参考价值，但缺少可复现的技术细节。

items.title: Introducing ChatGPT Images 2.5
items.summary_raw: ChatGPT Images 2.5 helps turn your ideas, sketches, and reference photos into more personalized, polished images that better reflect your ideas.
items.summary: OpenAI 发布 ChatGPT Images 2.5，主打将用户的想法、草图与参考照片转化为更个性化、更精致的图像，强调对用户意图的还原度与成图质量提升。这是 ChatGPT 内置图像生成/编辑能力的版本迭代，属于多模态产品线的常规更新，值得关注的是其在个性化与参考图控制上的改进方向，对关注文生图落地与 Agent 多模态工具链的开发者有参考意义。

items.title: On the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem
items.summary_raw: We’re sharing an AI-generated solution to the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem, including a writeup and a formal proof in Lean.
items.summary: OpenAI 发布了一篇声称由 AI 生成的纳维-斯托克斯方程千禧年大奖难题解答，包含文字说明与 Lean 形式化证明。该问题属于数学与流体力学最核心的未解难题之一，若成立将是 AI 在数学发现上的里程碑式突破。值得关注的是其形式化验证路径与 AI 推理能力边界，但需谨慎对待其正确性与同行评审状态。

items.title: Funding grants for new research into AI and teen development
items.summary_raw: Apply now for OpenAI’s $5 million grant program supporting independent research on how generative AI affects teen development, well-being, and safety.
items.summary: OpenAI 宣布设立 500 万美元资助计划，面向独立研究者征集关于生成式 AI 如何影响青少年发展、心理健康与安全的研究提案。该计划试图在 AI 产品大规模进入青少年日常使用的背景下，补齐长期缺失的实证证据，为政策制定、产品设计与家长决策提供依据。对关注 AI 社会影响、AI 安全与教育科技的研究者和团队而言，这是一个明确的资金与议题信号。

items.title: OpenAI expands initiatives to support journalism from classrooms to newsrooms
items.summary_raw: OpenAI is expanding support for journalism with tools, training, and partnerships for students, educators, journalists, and news organizations.
items.summary: OpenAI 宣布扩大对新闻业的支持计划，覆盖从课堂到新闻编辑室的场景，通过工具、培训和合作项目服务学生、教育者、记者与新闻机构。这属于企业生态与政策公关类动态，反映 OpenAI 在媒体行业的关系建设与产品落地路径，对关注 AI 与内容产业结合、媒体合规与版权议题的从业者有参考价值，但本身不含技术细节或可复用工程方案。

items.title: 1Password increases engineering productivity 21% with Codex
items.summary_raw: Engineers at 1Password use Codex to rapidly build new features and internal tools, reaching production-readiness while maintaining rigorous security policies.
items.summary: OpenAI 官方博客披露的客户案例：密码管理公司 1Password 的工程团队使用 Codex 辅助开发新功能与内部工具，工程生产力提升 21%，同时在严格的安全合规策略下达到可上线状态。该案例的价值在于展示了 AI 编码助手在安全敏感型组织中的落地路径与量化收益，为评估 Codex 类工具的实际 ROI 提供了厂商侧参考数据，但需注意其宣传属性，21% 的度量口径未公开。

items.title: Supporting independent journalism in Ukraine
items.summary_raw: OpenAI, AIRPPU and WAN-IFRA launch an AI program to help Ukrainian news organizations strengthen innovation, resilience, and independent journalism.
items.summary: OpenAI 联合 AIRPPU 与 WAN-IFRA 推出面向乌克兰新闻机构的 AI 支持计划，旨在帮助当地媒体提升创新能力、运营韧性并维护独立新闻报道。该消息本身不涉及模型或技术细节，属于企业社会责任与生态合作类公告，对关注 AI 在新闻业落地、AI 治理与公共价值议题的从业者有一定参考意义，但对工程实践的直接帮助有限。
